issues.message: Experience has not been assessed as ready.

limits: Experience cannot execute the native Canvas/WebGL game, physics, replay clock or video encoder. Whole-product readiness remains blocked.
The 4 prototype journeys check navigation, including export cancellation; they do not prove a race finish or a downloaded file.
The numeric replay field remains a prototype approximation: input changes do not run validations or clamp time like the native range input.
356 unique keys cover 446 feature elements; shared entity/state keys retain all feature-specific locations locally but Studio consumes one primary location.
These spans prove traceability, not exhaustive correctness. Model checking was bounded and truncated for some features.
Studio sync changes feature timestamps. Versions were refreshed from the same finalized sources after the successful sync; zero drift was then verified without another metadata-changing sync.
